interpretation.behavior: Mean smoke survival changes 253.8, 295.1, 220.2, 310.0; final exceeds epoch eight by 56.2 frames with 7 seeds better and 3 worse, but the curve is not monotonic and all snapshots complete zero patterns.
interpretation.conclusion: Additional updates improve fixed-data fit and produce some actual survival changes, but held-out loss and weak visited-path agreement show poor generalization. These results do not establish robust behavioral learning or teacher qualification.
interpretation.heldout: Held-out cross entropy worsens from 0.8592238985667936 to 1.267764019114762; onset improves 20/142 to 39/142 while continuation declines 116/195 to 100/195.
interpretation.training_fit: Final-model training cross entropy falls at every snapshot; final training all/onset gates remain unmet.

limits.enforcement: cooperative; individual calls not preempted; failure retention may run after cap

scope: Artifact verification only; no training, evaluation, probes, tests, or qualification were launched by this verification.
